articles.title: Welcome to City of Belton
articles.excerpt: The Strategic Plan document informs the decision-making process of the Belton City Council. It is a living document typically updated on an annual basis, with more comprehensive update occurring every five years.

articles.title: City Council
articles.excerpt: The council develops a Strategic Plan, and establishes fees and rates for city goods and services.

articles.title: CANDIDATE / OFFICEHOLDER CAMPAIGN FINANCE REPORT
articles.excerpt: Beginning on January 1, 2024, a candidate or officeholder who has accepted more than $32,810 in political contributions or made more than $32,810 in political expenditures in any calendar year must file all subsequent reports electronically.
